sentences.en: Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.

article.en: Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.
article.zh: 傍晚时分，孩子们在田野中央搭起了帐篷。

article.en: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire.
article.zh: 这件事刚刚做完，他们就在篝火上烧起了饭。

article.en: After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the campfire.
article.zh: 他们美美地吃了一顿饭后，就围在营火旁讲起了故事，唱起了歌。

article.en: But some time later it began to rain.
article.zh: 但过了一阵子，天下起雨来。

article.en: The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent.
article.zh: 孩子们感到累了，于是他们扑灭了篝火，钻进了帐篷。

article.en: Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly.
article.zh: 睡袋既暖和又舒服，所以他们都睡得很香。

article.en: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting.
article.zh: 午夜时分，有两个孩子醒了，大声叫了起来。

article.en: The tent was full of water!
article.zh: 原来帐篷里到处都是水！

article.en: It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field.
article.zh: 雨下得很大，他们发现地上已经形成了一条小溪。

article.en: The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!
article.zh: 那小溪弯弯曲曲穿过田野，然后正好从他们的帐篷底下流过去！
